resources.string: Use this device as an extra display for a Mac or a Windows PC.
Waiting for the computer on the cable…
Turn on sharing in Osplay on the Mac, then plug in the cable. A PC cannot use the cable yet; open its own network instead.
Looking for computers… On the computer, open Osplay and choose Extend this Mac or Extend this PC.

This device and the computer must be on the same network. Without Wi-Fi: with a Mac, use the USB cable below; with a PC, open the PC\'s own network (No router? in Osplay on the PC) or turn on USB tethering (in Settings, under hotspot and tethering).
Update Osplay on this computer to use it here
Computers show this device by this name.
Check that the computer shows the same code, then confirm on both.
%1$d fps · %2$s Mbit/s · RTT %3$d ms · loss %4$s%% · latency %5$s ms
Osplay\'s stored keys are damaged. Clear Osplay\'s storage in Android settings and pair again.
Osplay could not create its device key.
Android\'s key store refused Osplay\'s key (%1$s).
Looking for computers failed (error %1$d). Check that Wi-Fi is on.
This computer runs a different Osplay version. Update both to the latest version.
Osplay on %1$s is too old for this device. Update it to version 0.2 or later.
Osplay could not read this device\'s screen size.
The computer refused this device. It may have been removed from its paired devices.
The computer already uses all the displays it can extend onto.
The connection to the computer was lost.
The computer sent data Osplay does not understand. Update Osplay on both devices.
The connection\'s encryption check failed, so it was closed. Connect again; if it keeps happening, check the network.
Android could not provide secure random numbers. Restart the device and try again.
The computer ended the session because of an error there. Check Osplay on that computer.
Osplay is still closing the previous session. Try again in a moment.
